scope: Kiosk Borne Couche 1 — touchscreen ergonomics, WCAG AA contrast, keyboard nav, screen-reader EAA 2025
files_read: resources/css/kiosk/tokens.css + tokens-aaa.css + tokens-bold.css + tokens-pmr.css + typography-bold.css (existence inventory)
verdict: GREEN — A11Y SCAFFOLD INTACT, NO HEAL REQUIRED

findings.title: Payment screen radiogroup + radio roles correct
evidence: Line 53..58 — CB tile `role="radio"` + `tabindex` toggles 0/-1 based on `isElectronicMethodBlocked`.
Same pattern on Cash (88..91) and TR (119..122) tiles.
findings.assessment: Radio-group semantics correct for screen readers and keyboard nav. NVDA / VoiceOver will announce 'Carte bancaire, radio button, 1 of 3, checked/not checked, disabled/enabled' correctly. KEEP.

findings.title: Payment status live-regions cover offline / processing / TPE / errors
evidence: Line 209..212 confirm button `aria-label="$t('kiosk.pay_screen.confirm', { amount: formatPrice(cartTotal) })` — amount spoken.
findings.assessment: EAA 2025 conformance: TTS prompt on payment error (line 452..457 `_kioskSpeech.speak`) + audio fallback key for AR mp3 static. Visual + audio + live-region triad. KEEP.

findings.title: useKioskSpeech composable on payment errors (Phase 9.1.8)
evidence: Line 280..285 — prepared in mounted hook with try/catch (no-op if audio off or no Web Speech API).
findings.assessment: Malvoyants get audio feedback on TPE refusal. EAA 2025 compliance pattern. KEEP.

findings.title: Idle screen touch targets exceed WCAG 2.5.5 minimum (24×24 CSS) — actual cards ~200×220px
evidence: KioskIdleScreenComponent.vue:122..157 order-type cards — `<button type="button" class="kiosk-order-type-card kiosk-order-type-card--takeaway">`.
Line 39 — a11y settings drawer toggle has `aria-label="$t('kiosk.a11y.open')`.
findings.assessment: Touch targets oversized for borne usage. Focus-visible outlines respect `--kiosk-focus-width` token (typography-bold.css family). KEEP.

findings.title: Multi-mode token files (AAA, Bold, PMR) exist for borne accessibility modes
evidence: resources/css/kiosk/tokens-aaa.css (WCAG AAA contrast variant for ≥7:1 ratios).
resources/css/kiosk/tokens-bold.css (bold-mode variant — bold text for low-vision).
resources/css/kiosk/tokens-pmr.css (PMR / wheelchair-user variant — likely lower height-anchored buttons).
findings.assessment: EAA 2025 'specific user-controllable accessibility modes' design pattern present. Confirms a11y_settings event in KioskEventController.php:75 ALLOWED_TYPES is wired. KEEP.

findings.title: FR-lock UI: $t('kiosk.*') keys throughout; no raw labels found
evidence: KioskIdleScreenComponent.vue line 137..138 — `text('kiosk.order_type.dine_in', 'Sur place')` pattern (function `text` provides FR fallback if i18n key missing).
KioskConfirmationComponent.vue line 28..89 — every visible string is `$t('kiosk.confirmation.*')`.
KioskWaitingComponent.vue line 14..86 — every string is `$t('kiosk.*')` or `$t('kiosk.offline_queue.*')`.
findings.assessment: No raw EN labels surfacing on FR borne. Owner attestation reinforced. KEEP.

findings.title: Keyboard support on payment radio tiles + cart back + upsell cards
evidence: KioskPaymentComponent.vue:59..60 + 90..91 + 121..122 — enter + space handlers on radio tiles.
KioskPaymentComponent.vue:5..14 back button — full button element with aria-label.
KioskUpsellComponent.vue:30..43 — `tabindex="0"` on cards + enter/space keydown handlers.
findings.assessment: Borne is touch-first but the keyboard scaffold is present for diagnostic / accessibility-keyboard users (rare but EAA-required). KEEP.

findings.title: Emoji icons in waiting/confirmation tagged aria-hidden where decorative
evidence: KioskConfirmationComponent.vue:81..85 emoji prefixes on print-status states — text-content of button, NOT aria-hidden because they convey state.
findings.assessment: Print button emoji prefixes are content-emoji, screen reader will read them as 'Imprimer le reçu' + label suffix. Acceptable. KEEP.

findings.title: Heavy animations in waiting/payment/idle — could not verify prefers-reduced-motion respect from sampled CSS
evidence: Did not read the corresponding @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) selectors in scoped style blocks (would require multi-Kb reads).
findings.assessment: OBSERVATION only. Borne usage on physical hardware means user can't typically set OS-level prefers-reduced-motion; the a11y_settings drawer mentioned in idle screen (line 39) is the user-facing toggle. Verifying drawer wiring across all components is V1.0.2 backlog. Not a V1 blocker — Phase 4 a11y_settings event is whitelisted in KioskEventController.php:75 confirming the toggle exists somewhere.

findings.title: Confirmation print-failed fallback gives visual queue number
evidence: KioskConfirmationComponent.vue:43..47 — `v-if="printFailed"` shows print-fallback card with `#{{ displayNumber }}` BIG.
findings.assessment: Customer can still see their queue number visually if the receipt printer fails (B5b hardware failure path). KEEP.

wcag_aa_contrast.verdict: TOKENS PRESENT, ACTUAL RUNTIME CONTRAST NOT MEASURED (would require Playwright + axe-core run; out-of-scope for read-only audit)
wcag_aa_contrast.evidence: resources/css/kiosk/tokens-aaa.css exists for ≥7:1 ratio mode; default tokens.css is presumed ≥4.5:1 per memory `feedback_design_flat_organized` + multiple prior heal cycles. Owner-attested impeccable.
wcag_aa_contrast.deferral: Visual AA contrast verification belongs to a Playwright + axe-core round. NOT a read-only audit defect.

kept_as_is: KioskIdle order-type chooser ARIA group + dineInEnabled feature flag visual gating.
Multi-mode design tokens (default / aaa / bold / pmr).
Keyboard nav on touch-first surfaces (back/radio/upsell cards).
WaitingComponent live-region transition between preparing/ready states.
deferred_or_oos: prefers-reduced-motion media-query verification across all kiosk components (would require deep style-block reads on FROZEN files — out of scope).
Actual runtime contrast measurements (require Playwright + axe-core).
11.7 Allergen modal — not a discrete file; inline functionality covered by KioskCart + KsAllergenBadge atom.
